LESSON: HANDLING THE BIBLE BIBLE

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HOLY
Topic 2.2: Handling the Bible BIBLE

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Handling the Bible BIBLE. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we take care of BIBLE the learner should be able various ways of handling the Bible?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. sing simple songs on the Bible as a holy book (2 how to handle the Bible Timothy 3:15 – 16)
2. appreciate the with respect as the word of importance of handling God the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HANDLING THE BIBLE BIBLE
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: PP2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Handling the Bible BIBLE helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HANDLING THE BIBLE BIBLE
Study Handling the Bible BIBLE like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Sing simple songs on the Bible as a holy book (2 how to handle the Bible Timothy 3:15 – 16)

What this means
In this part you learn to sing simple songs on the Bible as a holy book (2 how to handle the Bible Timothy 3:15 – 16). You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: sing simple songs on the Bible as a holy book (2 how to handle the Bible Timothy 3:15 – 16).
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Handling the Bible BIBLE” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can sing simple songs on the Bible as a holy book (2 how to handle the Bible Timothy 3:15 – 16). Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the with respect as the word of importance of handling God the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the with respect as the word of importance of handling God the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the with respect as the word of importance of handling God the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Handling the Bible BIBLE in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the with respect as the word of importance of handling God the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Handling the Bible BIBLE is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Handling the Bible BIBLE” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: sing simple songs on the Bible as a holy book (2 how to handle the Bible Timothy 3:15 – 16))

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Handling the Bible BIBLE in your own words. (skill: appreciate the with respect as the word of importance of handling God the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Handling the Bible BIBLE to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: sing simple songs on the Bible as a holy book (2 how to handle the Bible Timothy 3:15 – 16).
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the with respect as the word of importance of handling God the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Handling the Bible BIBLE from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Handling the Bible BIBLE: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Handling the Bible BIBLE?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we take care of BIBLE the learner should be able various ways of handling the Bible?

3. How do we carry the a Holy book used by (Deuteronomy 17:19) Bible?

1. Know what Handling the Bible BIBLE means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: sing simple songs on the Bible as a holy book (2 how to handle the Bible Timothy 3:15 – 16).
